summary: Completed public API regression and browser E2E coverage for authentication, dashboard/map, AI detection, AIS, archive, alerts, reports, and settings. Backend 8/8 passed and all requested UI flows completed.

critical.issue: With credentials enabled, preflight reflects arbitrary Origin (tested https://evil.example). Restrict allow_origins to the configured frontend origin.
Report generation uses get_current_user_optional, so reports can be created without authentication; require get_current_user for this operational action.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout/login_attempts behavior is implemented after repeated failed logins, despite auth playbook requirement.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext catches 401 from /api/auth/me and installs a hardcoded demo admin user, allowing the full console to render without a valid JWT.

issues: Browser console reports invalid HTML/hydration warning because a span is rendered inside each select option (React: <span> cannot be a child of <option>).

action_items: Remove the AuthContext demo-user fallback and redirect unauthenticated users to /login.
Restrict credentialed CORS to the configured frontend origin.
Require authentication for report generation and implement login attempt lockout if required by the auth contract.
Render plain text in ReportsPage select option labels to remove the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses fallback defaults for MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, and JWT_SECRET instead of failing fast when environment configuration is missing.
Frontend routes are not protected by authentication; the current fallback effectively bypasses JWT authorization.

success_rate.frontend: 100% requested flows completed; console warnings present

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST-990001 AIS vessel through the CSV upload test and generated a detection/report; seeded records were otherwise not modified except resolving an existing alert during E2E testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested navigation and core interactions were exercised against the public preview URL. Re-test unauthenticated route access, CORS preflight, report authorization, and the Reports option warning after fixes.
rca of the issue: The unauthenticated access is caused by AuthContext.checkAuth catching any /auth/me failure and assigning a static admin object rather than leaving user null. The CORS issue is caused by allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True; Starlette reflects arbitrary origins during credentialed preflight. The report authorization gap is caused by Depends(get_current_user_optional).
